readthedocs.org.t: Full featured documentation deployment platform - Read the Docs
readthedocs.org.ds: Read the Docs is a documentation building and hosting platform aimed at helping developers creating documentation from code with versioned documentation, integrated search, pull request previews and more.

giveawayoftheday.com.ds: Every day we present FREE licensed software published by developers from all over the world.

npshistory.com.t: National Park Service History Electronic Library & Archive
npshistory.com.ds: Electronic Library and Archive containing digital editions of documents published by or about the National Park Service and the National Parks, National Monuments, National Historic Sites covering their natural and cultural history

benton.org.t: Benton Institute for Broadband & Society | Broadband Delivers Opportunities and Strengthens Communities
benton.org.ds: Benton provides the only free, reliable, and non-partisan daily digest that curates and distributes news related to universal broadband. Our goal is to bring open, affordable, high-capacity broadband to all people in the U.S. to ensure a thriving democracy.
